messages:
alex: Heads up — planning an unpin of runtime v2.15 -> v2.16 on CANARY tonight (02:00-03:00 UTC). Observed KV-cache latency bump in the latest canary runs, want to validate the shim fixes before wide rollout.

maya: Thanks. Is this an immediate rollback if errors spike? What's the abort criteria? :eyes:

alex: Abort if 5xx rate > 0.5% over a 5m window OR median latency regresses > 25% vs baseline. We'll do a small cohort first (10% of canary).

deploy-bot: Schedule accepted. unpin-request(id=unpin-3601234567) queued for 2024-11-03T02:00:00Z. Cohort: canary-1a (10%). Notify: #eng-releases.

sam: Quick question — do we need an SDK pin for clients using streaming/flush hooks? There was an SDK change in 3.4.1 that adjusted chunking behavior.

natalie: SDK 3.4.1 is backward compatible for non-streaming paths, but streaming had a minor API tweak. If you expect streaming-heavy traffic in the canary, keep the SDK pinned to 3.4.0 for the cohort.

alex: Good catch. We'll add SDK pin to the canary config for the 10% cohort: sdk=3.4.0. Runtime unpin will proceed but only for requests without streaming flag.

alex: Also flag for ML: if quantized models are in the canary, tj pls confirm quant kernels are compatible with v2.16.

@tj: Looking. Quick read: v2.16 kernel selector has a fallback changed for int8 GEMM; should be fine but there's a corner case for long-seq quantized Llama where perf degrades. I'll run a quick long-seq sample tonight and post numbers.

deploy-bot: unpin-started(id=unpin-3601234567) 2024-11-03T02:00:05Z cohort=canary-1a. Targets: runtime-v2.16 for non-stream requests, sdk-pin=3.4.0 enforced.

alex: Rolling out to cohort now. Monitoring: latency, 5xx, token throughput.

(02:07) tj: Ran long-seq test on quant-llama sample. Median latency +32% and P95 +48% vs v2.15 for sequences >2048.

alex: Oof. That's past our 25% threshold for median. Initiating immediate rollback for cohort.

deploy-bot: rollback-init(id=unpin-3601234567) 2024-11-03T02:09:10Z reason="quant long-seq perf regression". Rolling runtime back to v2.15 for cohort canary-1a.

maya: Any errors or customer-facing incidents?

sam: Observed a tiny spike in 502s during window but dropped after rollback start. Not customer-impacting beyond internal canary.

alex: Good. Leave follow-up: we need a quant kernel fix or a compatibility shim. Opening ticket INF-4821 to track: include repro, perf traces, and kernel selection logs.

natalie: I'll coordinate SDK note: add a short blurb to release notes that quantized long-seq users should avoid v2.16 until INF-4821 is resolved.

tj: I'll attach the perf traces to the ticket and try a micro-optimization PR tomorrow.

alex: TL;DR: unpin scheduled and started, perf regression detected (quant long-seq), rollback executed, canary stable. Action items: INF-4821 assigned (tj), add release note caveat (natalie), consider a second canary after kernel fix.

deploy-bot: unpin-complete(id=unpin-3601234567) 2024-11-03T02:20:00Z status=rolled_back.

alex: Thanks everyone. We should also add a preflight long-seq quant test to the unpin checklist so this doesn't slip past next time. I'll update the runbook. :thumbsup:

maya: Agreed. Please ping when the kernel PR is up so QE can run an extended canary.

alex: Will do — closing thread but keeping INF-4821 open for follow-up.

(02:40) deploy-bot: thread-closed(id=unpin-3601234567)
